ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Workstation Locking via Rundll32
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious call to the user32.dll function that locks the user workstation

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*user32\\\.dll\\,.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*LockWorkStation.*"))
